#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

int main() {
    int r = readInt();
    int c = readInt();
    std::string line;
    getline(cin, line); // consume the rest of the line after integers
    getline(cin, line);
    vector<char> cs(line.begin(), line.end());

    int max_dim = 2 * (r + c);
    std::vector<std::vector<long>> C(max_dim + 1, std::vector<long>(max_dim + 1, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= max_dim; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= max_dim; j++) {
            if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    int v1 = r + c;
    int v2 = r + c;
    long x = 0, y = 0;
    while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
        if (x > y) {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long s2 = C[v2][r];
            y += c1 * s2;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long s1 = C[v1][r];
            long c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            x += s1 * c2;
            v2--;
        }
    }

    long best = std::abs(x - y);

    // DFS function
    std::function<void(long, long, int, int)> dfs = [&](long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long d = std::abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            if (d < best) best = d;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 > 0) {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long s2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0) {
            long s1 = C[v1][r];
            long c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    };

    // solve function with memoization
    std::map<long, long> cache;
    auto solve = [&](long x, long y, int v1, int v2) -> long {
        long k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = cache.find(k);
        if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
        long v = 0;
        long d = std::abs(x - y);
        if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best) {
            cache[k] = v;
            return v;
        }
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            cache[k] = 1;
            return 1;
        }
        char c = cs[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long s2 = C[v2][r];
            v += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
            long s1 = C[v1][r];
            long c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            v += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cache[k] = v;
        return v;
    };

    // Initialize counters
    std::vector<int> cntA(2 * (r + c) + 1, 0);
    std::vector<int> cntB(2 * (r + c) + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (cs[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (cs[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }

    long ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    std::cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
